description: This file defines the EndpointCollectionResult class, which extends AbstractEndpointResult, and provides normalization methods for collections within the OrangeHRM Core API v2. It appears to handle serialization and normalization of data collections, distinguishing how collections are processed based on class interfaces.

classes.name: EndpointCollectionResult
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractEndpointResult to provide normalization logic for collections, determining whether to normalize as an object or an array based on implemented interfaces.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the model data; returns a normalized object or array depending on whether the model class implements CollectionNormalizable.
